schema.title: Transaction Record Schema
schema.description: Schema for parsing transaction record emails, including date, service name, transaction details, amount, category, currency, and card.

date.description: Transaction date, can refer to email date or transaction date in content. If multiple dates exist, use the earliest date. Format is 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm', e.g., '2024-09-02 10:12'.

service.description: Name of service or store, e.g., 'GOOGLE', 'Uber', etc.

details.description: Detailed transaction information, such as overseas purchase, online purchase, restaurant name, or consumption details. Can be empty or null if not available.
examples: Uber: From Fuxing North Road to Minquan East Road

amount.description: Transaction amount. For USD, keep two decimal places (e.g., 50.12); for TWD, use integers (e.g., 550).

currency.description: Currency code used for the transaction, if amount starts with NT$, currency is TWD.

inputs.system:
Please analyze the following email to extract transaction details for bookkeeping purposes.

Please extract relevant transaction details such as transaction date, amount, merchant name, and any other pertinent information, and provide them in a structured format suitable for accounting records.

schema.title: Expense Record Schema
schema.description: Schema used to parse expense record emails, including date, service name, transaction details, amount, category, currency, and card.

date.description: Transaction date, can refer to the email date or the consumption date within the content. If there are multiple dates, use the earliest one. The format is 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm', e.g., '2024-09-02 10:12'.

service.description: Name of the service or store, such as 'GOOGLE', 'Uber', etc.

details.description: Detailed transaction information, such as overseas card usage, online transactions, restaurant names, or consumption details. If none, can be left blank or null.
examples: Uber: from Fuxing North Road to Minquan East Road

amount.description: Transaction amount. If in USD, keep two decimal places (e.g., 50.12); if in TWD, use integers (e.g., 550).

currency.description: Currency code used in the transaction. If the amount starts with NT$, then currency is TWD.

card.description: Credit card used for the transaction.

"Get invoice": after import, register the googlesuper webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.

"Get payment": after import, register the googlesuper webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Google Sheets spreadsheet id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

"Extract invoice" (extractFromFile.pdf): Parsed via googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_PARSE_FILE; the file must live on Google Drive (upload first if the previous step only has bytes/base64).

"HTML" (html.extractHtmlContent): CSS selectors become a structured-output LLM extract; verify results on a real page.
"HTML" extracted HTML with CSS selectors; on Yantra a structured-output step reads the page instead. Check the result on a real page, and trim very large pages before this step.
"Merge" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was append).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
# A. Get data
- Set up labels in Gmail
- Suggested using Gmail filters to move emails to labels automatically

# B. Deal with the data
1. Multiple payment info in one mail: input the "sender" of the emails that contain more than one payment info. e.g. credit card daily spend notification
2. One payment info in one mail: input the "sender" of the emails that contain only one payment info. e.g. instant credit card spend notification
3. Invoices: input the mails that contain one invoice in one mail

# C. Get spend details and send to google sheet
- Edit the output schema to fit your google sheet format
- Edit the prompt to fit your needs
